an6.75:1.1: 75 chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ saupāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṃkhā
an6.75:1.3: kāmavitakkena byāpādavitakkena vihiṃsāvitakkena kāmasaññāya byāpādasaññāya vihiṃsāsaññāya
an6.75:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ saupāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṃkhā.
an6.75:2.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ viharati avighātaṃ anupāyāsaṃ apariḷāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaṇā sugati pāṭikaṃkhā
an6.75:2.3: nekkhammavitakkena abyāpādavitakkena avihiṃsāvitakkena nekkhammasaññāya abyāpādasaññāya avihiṃsāsaññāya
an6.75:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ viharati avighātaṃ anupāyāsaṃ apariḷāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugati pāṭikaṃkhāti.
